summary: Graduated contractor -> vendor transition: selective access removal, device repatriation, and KMS/service-account split
description:
Issue summary: Alex Reyes (contractor, Eng Tools) transitioned to an external vendor (Neptune AI) on 2026-03-01. HR flagged that Alex has a mix of permanent Redwood service accounts and contractor accounts; Neptune will continue supporting the same project under a vendor contract. We need a selective offboarding: remove internal-facing privileges, retain audited vendor-scoped access, repatriate company laptop, and rotate KMS/service-account credentials tied to datasets.

Impact: If left as-is, Alex (now vendor) retains elevated internal privileges and access to internal-only datasets. Potential for stale credentials (service-account keys / user tokens) and an unmanaged laptop in circulation. Risk: medium — compliance/security + billing for reserved resources.

Desired outcome: 1) Remove or downgrade any internal-only RBAC from Alex's Redwood identity. 2) Create a vendor-scoped service-account for Neptune integration with least privilege, migrate long-lived workloads off Alex-owned keys, and rotate KMS key bindings where required. 3) Retrieve company laptop (asset TAG RW-3319) and ensure disk wipe + reimage. 4) Produce a short audit trail (confluence + exported CSV) capturing steps and dates.

Context/constraints: Neptune requires access to a subset of production logs and the model serving telemetry for continuing support; legal requested a minimal data scope and an auditable handoff. There is a currently-enabled long-lived service-account (svc-engtools-alex) used in a nightly export job to S3 and also referenced in a Grafana datasource. KMS key arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:123456789012:key/a1b2c3 referenced in export job ACLs.
steps_to_reproduce: N/A - operational coordination ticket rather than a bug. Steps included in plan below.
investigation_notes:
- Inventory: svc-engtools-alex has active key last used 2026-03-08; Grafana datasource still uses it.
- Asset: laptop RW-3319 reported by contractor as in possession; last heartbeat 2026-03-10 via MDM.
- KMS: key a1b2c3 used to encrypt nightly exports; export job runs on dedicated pipeline 'engtools-export' (sched-prod).
- Dependencies: Two SRE-run jobs reference svc-engtools-alex; one is safe to migrate during a maintenance window, the other is the nightly export (requires coordination with Neptune legal for allowed dataset fields).
planned_actions: 1) Create vendor-scoped service account svc-neptune-support with explicit IAM role granting only export-read and telemetry-read. 2) Schedule migration: swap Grafana datasource and nightly job to svc-neptune-support during maintenance window 2026-03-17 02:00-04:00 UTC. 3) Rotate keys: deactivate svc-engtools-alex keys, create new keys for internal owners, and rotate KMS CMK permissions to remove alex@redwood. 4) Device: arrange return label with Logistics partner (SLA 7 business days), collect RW-3319, perform corporate wipe and reimage. 5) Produce confluence audit note and attach logs + PR links.
comments: 2026-03-10 10:12 - Maya Chen (HR): Alex's last day as headcount was 2026-02-28; vendor contract effective 2026-03-01. HR would like the least disruptive transition; Neptune legal attached the allowed data fields in the vendor contract (see confluence link).

2026-03-10 13:05 - Liam O'Connor (Security): Initial inventory done. svc-engtools-alex key last used 2026-03-08. We should not cut the key until svc-neptune-support is provisioned and tested. Recommend maintenance window and a rollback plan.

2026-03-11 09:27 - Priya Nair (SRE): Grafana datasource owner acknowledged. We can swap to svc-neptune-support in the March 17 window. I will prepare a PR to update datasource creds and pipeline config.

2026-03-11 15:40 - Kunal Sharma (Device Ops): Noted asset RW-3319. Will open a logistics return ticket and generate UPS label. ETA pickup within 5-7 business days after authorization. Need confirmation from Security on acceptance criteria for wipe.

2026-03-12 08:04 - Elena Gomez (Legal): Confirmed vendor contract allows telemetry and aggregated export fields only. Do not include PII or raw user content. Legal requests a snapshot of export fields pre/post-migration.
2026-03-12 14:10 - Liam O'Connor (Security): Added checklist for CMK permission removal, KMS rotation, and PR approval steps. Will coordinate with SRE during the window.

2026-03-13 11:55 - Maya Chen (HR): HR approves proposed schedule. Please include confirmation when laptop pickup scheduled. Also request that access removal for internal Slack/SSO happens on 2026-03-18 after successful migration.
next_steps:
- Provision svc-neptune-support (IAM) and share test creds with Neptune.
- Prepare infra PR to switch Grafana and export job to new service-account.
- Schedule maintenance window 2026-03-17 02:00-04:00 UTC.
- Coordinate KMS permission change with Security during window; ensure key rotation plan documented in PR.
- Authorize Logistics to pickup RW-3319 and track shipping.
- Post-migration: revoke alex@redwood SSO access and mark internal accounts for closure 2026-03-18.
